title: Regulated Google Workspace — Assured Controls, ITAR & DFARS Compliance
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Google Workspace + Gemini enterprise transformation; architecture/governance/integration or migration work, live-environment care).

Google Admin console + Microsoft/Entra authored click-by-click from public docs; Gemini Enterprise preview/rolling-out capabilities cited or flagged 'verify in tenant', never invented; third-party migration-tool and enterprise-app internals deferred to vendor docs.
hook: Run Google Workspace for regulated, controlled data
problem: Enterprises with ITAR/DFARS obligations can't just turn on Google Workspace — controlled data needs sovereignty, access, and support boundaries. This solution configures regulated Google Workspace using Assured Controls and related capabilities: data-region residency, access-management/support controls, and the policy configuration that aligns Workspace to ITAR/DFARS and internal compliance, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how Assured Controls, data regions, access management, and support controls map to ITAR/DFARS and controlled-data requirements.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites (Assured Controls / appropriate Workspace edition + add-ons, compliance/legal stakeholders, data classification, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.

Implementation Guide — exact steps to configure data-region residency, access/support controls, and the policy set for controlled data, validate against the compliance requirements on a pilot, then expand.
5 supporting scripts — controlled-data posture discovery, per-scope controls validation, a compliance coverage/evidence report, safe remediation, and a scope helper.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides plus Best Practices for evidence and audit; regulatory interpretation is deferred to legal/compliance (cite, don't invent).
short: Configure regulated Google Workspace with Assured Controls — data-region residency, access/support controls, and policy aligned to ITAR/DFARS and internal compliance — for controlled data, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
